text:
deploy-bot: Staged rollout started for service/backend v2.14.0 -> traffic 0% -> 15% over 30m. Release notes: https://redwood.example/release/v2.14.0 :rocket:
lauren (Product): Heads up — change window still green until 18:30 PT, we planned small ramp to 15% then monitor.
rahul (SRE): seeing a bump in 5xx from EU edge at ~10% traffic. Not huge but sustained. ETA on metrics panel?
zoe (Infra): pulling logs, looks like an Nginx upstream timeout to the new pool in eu-west-1. 502/504 spike ~ 30s ago.
sam (Eng): can we pause at 10% and scope? If it's a routing/k8s probe issue we should stop ramp and pin EU to prior version.
lauren (Product): vote: stop at 10% and partial pin EU, or continue to 15% and watch? :thumbsup: stop/pin, :thumbsdown: continue
rahul (SRE): +1 stop, want a clean rollback plan if error budget crosses 0.2% in next 5m.
zoe (Infra): I can pin the eu route to v2.13.9 for customer-facing clusters and leave global at 10%. Command I will run:
```
infra pin-version --route backend-eu --version v2.13.9 --reason "eu 5xx spike during v2.14 rollout"
```
deploy-bot: metric snapshot: 1m5xx rate eu-west increased from 0.03% -> 0.65%, overall p50/p95 unchanged. Logs: `upstream timeout` 78 events last 60s.
sam (Eng): can you also dump the readiness probe logs for the new pool? suspect probe timeout due to longer cold start.
zoe (Infra): grabbing probe logs now, provisioning note: new instance type bumped JVM GC flags which increased startup wallclock by ~400ms. Might cause probe flapping under load ramp.
lauren (Product): consensus so far: pause global ramp at 10%, pin EU to previous version, investigate probe and GC tuning, then retry EU-only canary with slower heat-up. Anyone object?
rahul (SRE): no objection. I'll set an alert for >0.5% 5xx in the next 10m and prepare rollback runbook.
sam (Eng): put a temporary circuit-breaker on the new pool: `k8s scale backend-newpool 0` if spike continues, but prefer pin first.
zoe (Infra): pin applied to backend-eu (running now). leaving global rollout at 10% and pausing scheduled increase.
lauren (Product): thanks — I'll update release notes and send a quick blurb to #customer-impact if needed. Link to ops checklist: https://redwood.example/ops/canary-checklist
deploy-bot: Staged rollout status: PAUSED at 10% (eu pinned to v2.13.9). Next action: infra postmortem if rollback executed.
lauren (Product): follow-up action items: 1) sam/eng check GC/probe reflights, 2) zoe validate pin and confirm traffic shifted, 3) rahul watch alert and clear to resume. We'll reconvene in 15m. :hourglass: 
sam (Eng): ack, starting probe trace now.
rahul (SRE): ack, monitoring dashboard up.
lauren (Product): thanks all — holding here.
